title: Musify v1.7.5 Update
changelog:
- Silence Trimmer: Auto-skip dead air and silent intros/outros
- Dynamic Artwork Palette Theming: Ambient background morphing to song art
- Fixed URLDecoder crash on Android 10/11/12 with Java desugaring
- Turbo Multi-chunk Downloader & 1-tap batch playlist downloads
- 100% offline lyrics bundling with interactive tap-to-seek karaoke
- Smart Playlist Deduplicator in 1 tap
- Mini-player horizontal swipe gestures (Next / Prev)
- Soft 45-second sleep timer volume fade-out
- Playback session restoration on startup
- Redesigned aesthetic update dialog matching app UI
